topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Code of conduct and sanctions policy (POL-01 4.8) covering CPNI misuse; annual acknowledgment of POL-05 by employees and vendor agents
evidence: Code of conduct; acknowledgment report (95%); sanctions log (3 CPNI-related)

control_description: Board audit committee receives quarterly cyber and regulatory reports directly from the vCISO
gap: Quarterly cyber reporting formalized only from 2026-09; one meeting on record
remediation: Hold and minute each quarterly report through the observation period

control_description: Reporting lines and authorities defined: COO sponsor, vCISO, CTO, Security Manager, Director of Business Services as service owner (POL-01 section 3)
Hiring with background checks; role-based training for Business Services engineers
gap: No role-based security training for Business Services and network engineers (P07 AT-3)

control_description: Control owners named in the SSP, standards, and POA&M; performance goals for directors include POA&M milestones
gap: POA&M milestones added to director objectives only for 2027
remediation: Track objectives during the observation period

control_description: Information for controls comes from the SIEM, OSS inventory, change system, and ticketing
gap: SYS-15 logs not in the SIEM; POP devices missing from inventory

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies and standards published on the intranet; quarterly security bulletins
gap: Standards STD-01 to STD-05 still in draft
remediation: Issue standards on the P06 schedule

control_description: Customer-facing commitments: Business Services contracts (99.99% hosted voice SLA; 24-hour incident notice); service descriptions; status page
gap: No published security commitments summary for Business Services customers; incident notice clause missing from 2023-era CLEC contracts
remediation: Customer security addendum for all Business Services contracts

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Objectives for Business Services availability and confidentiality set from the BIA (P05 BP-06, BP-07) and contracts
Risk assessment per SP 800-30 includes Business Services risks (P01 R-010, R-019, R-028, R-044, R-045, R-050)
Fraud risk considered: toll fraud and robocall origination by tenants
gap: Per-tenant fraud thresholds and know-your-customer checks not in place

control_description: Significant changes (new products, AI features, acquisitions) trigger a risk review
gap: Agent assist and chatbot launched without review; process now defined in P10
remediation: Apply the intake gate to every new Business Services feature

control_description: Annual independent assessment by the co-sourced internal audit firm; MDR monthly reports
Deficiencies tracked in the POA&M and reported quarterly to the audit committee
gap: POA&M reporting started 2026-09; no quarter completed
remediation: Two quarterly cycles before the observation period

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from the Moderate baseline and mapped to risks (P02, P01)
General IT controls for the hosted voice cluster, orchestrator, and supporting IT
gap: Baselines and privileged access for the hosted voice cluster are weak

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Controls deployed through POL-01 to POL-05 and standards
gap: Several standards in draft

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: Logical access to the hosted voice cluster, orchestrator, and customer portal
gap: Hosted voice cluster administered with shared local accounts without MFA; PAM does not cover it
remediation: Named accounts with MFA through PAM (POAM-002)

control_description: User registration through the IdP and HR feed; customer portal users created by customer administrators
evidence: IdP provisioning logs; portal admin guide
gap: Transfers keep prior roles (P07 AC-2)

control_description: Role-based access, least privilege, and removal
gap: Semiannual reviews; SYS-18 removals late

control_description: Data hall at CO-1: badge plus PIN, cameras, visitor escort, cage locks for colocation customers
Media and equipment disposal with certificates of destruction
gap: Returned customer SD-WAN devices are not wiped before refurbishment

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Boundary protection for the hosted voice cluster (SBCs, firewalls); remote access controls
gap: Vendor shared VPN account with standing access to the management network (P07 MA-4); SBCs near end of support

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: Encryption of data in transit (TLS for portals and SIP over TLS where customers support it; IPsec for SD-WAN)

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on servers in the hosted voice cluster and on all endpoints; MDR response

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities on Business Services components
gap: SBCs and hosted voice network elements not scanned; no drift monitoring

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
gap: Hosted voice cluster and orchestrator logs not in the SIEM

control_description: Evaluation of security events by the MDR and the security team
gap: No evaluation criteria for Business Services events

control_description: Incident response runbooks with customer notice (P08)
gap: Runbooks approved 2026-09-17, not exercised

control_description: Recovery from incidents
gap: Recovery procedures for the hosted voice cluster not written

control_description: Change authorization, testing, and approval for hosted voice, orchestrator, and supporting infrastructure
gap: 7 of 25 sampled changes had no review or approval record (5 hosted voice)
remediation: Change advisory board for Business Services (POAM-007)

control_description: Business disruption risk mitigation: standby node, generators, insurance
gap: Standby node in the same data hall; single cooling plant (P01 R-045)
remediation: Standby node at CO-4; second cooling unit

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Vendor and business partner risk management (hosted voice software vendor, orchestrator vendor, carriers)
gap: Orchestrator vendor SOC 2 reviewed; hosted voice software vendor has no SOC 2; 22 vendors unreviewed company-wide

control_description: Capacity management for the hosted voice cluster and SD-WAN orchestrator; monthly capacity reports
Environmental protections, backups, and recovery infrastructure for the data hall and cluster
evidence: Generator and UPS tests; backup reports
gap: Single cooling plant; cluster configuration backups nightly against a 15-minute RPO for routing changes
remediation: Second cooling unit; configuration snapshots every 15 minutes

control_description: Recovery plan testing for the hosted voice cluster
gap: No restore or failover test of the cluster configuration has been performed

topic_label: Identification and maintenance of confidential information
control_description: Identification and protection of confidential customer information (call records, configurations) per POL-04
gap: Customer call records in the hosted voice cluster are kept 24 months without a documented retention basis

control_description: Disposal of confidential information at contract end, with a certificate to the customer
